Alert on unexpected initialization of @sentry/node or similar telemetry SDKs in utility libraries. Watch for outbound network requests to hardcoded Sentry DSNs or other suspicious endpoints, particularly if accompanied by chunked or obfuscated payloads. Use static analysis to detect empty catch blocks in code that handles sensitive data or network operations. Scan for references to '../data' directory access and freezing of the console object in package code.
